Scope reviewed: detached worktree /tmp/storymodel4s-d2-v12.YBOE60 at exact base 18dc34c8e435659e87829e013ea66bdb204d58c9; only the uncommitted two-file diff in NARRATIVE_PROCESS_ALIGNMENT_NOTES.md and docs/plans/2026-08-29-movie-narrative-architecture.md.

Evidence: plan lines 142–160 make schema/content/derived-identity check state orthogonal to Draft runtime-observation authority; generic codec replay remains Draft and only the separately authorized E0 adapter-owned issued invocation/result plus append-only build-journal join may promote. Plan lines 793–796 preserve provider/decoder-free C1, read-only decoder-free D0/D1, and separately authorized E0. Notes lines 5525–5532 and 5632–5644 preserve the same ownership and explicitly state that valid content or identity does not prove decoder execution. The two-file diff passes git diff --check. I found no movie-admission or provenance loophole.

Boundary: this ACCEPT covers document content only. It is not authorization for package acquisition, decoder execution, source/media access, implementation, candidate landing, or history rewrite, and it does not cure or supersede the existing governance hold on the unauthorized V11 shared-history landing. Chief architect authority remains required for the non-rewriting corrective disposition. No files, commits, candidates, or tracker state were changed by this review.
